prompt: I want to modify the PrivateMessage table. Count and list all the aspx pages that can be directly impacted by this change.

count.description: Exact number of distinct .aspx pages found.

pages.description: The distinct .aspx page paths counted, by exact relative path from the repo root (e.g. 'admin/managermain.aspx').

justification.description: Which stored procedures, Blogic dispatcher members, and call chains were inspected to arrive at this count.
